description: This is an HTML source file that defines the structure and style of a web-based database viewer application, including embedded JavaScript for dynamic data fetching and interaction.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Loads the list of databases from the server and populates the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases, resetting current selections and fetching data anew.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Toggles the display of tables for a selected database, loading tables if necessary.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a specific database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data records from a selected table.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates the HTML table displaying data records.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Generates the HTML for a table cell based on the value type, with support for expandable content.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for long strings or objects.
